exposure: Time to pregnancy (TTP) categorized as <3 cycles, 3-5 cycles, 6-11 cycles, and ≥12 cycles
Spontaneous PTB and medically indicated PTB
cohort: 3,521 singletons born to women aged 18-40 years at cohort entry
finding: Delayed conception was associated with an increased risk of adverse birth outcomes, including preterm birth, low birth weight, placental disorders, and cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Longer TTP was associated with an increased risk of cesarean delivery.
